question.text: Match the statements in Column I with the properties Column II.

options.text: A-p, r; B-p, q, s; C-q, r; D-q, s
A-p; B-p, s; C-p; D-q, s
A-p, q; B-p, q; C-q, r; D-q, r
A-r, s; B-q; C-p; D-p, q, s

solution.text:
(A) When two circles are intersecting they have a common normal and common tangent.
(B) Two mutually extemal circles have a common normal and common tangent.
(C) When one circle lies inside of other, then they have a common normal but no common tangent.
(D) Two branches of a hyperbola have a common normal but no common tangent.
